description: Coverage battery (dev-type, used while fixing): one or more questions for every measure, level, time form and phrasing style. Each item states the plan the question must produce (intent / metric / item / place / level) and whether an answer with rows is expected. Built on 23 Nov 2026 after the 'area under agriculture' failure; failures found with it were fixed, so it is NOT a held-out set.
